works.title: lothea — On Love
works.summary: Gibran's whole teaching keeps its sword, cross, grain-floor, and sacred fire in close translation; the transmutation gives consent, fear, and shared bread their own answers.

works.title: phomila — On Children
works.summary: Gibran's bow remains visible in close translation; the transmutation gives the child to wind as seed rather than arrow.

works.title: loa — On Giving
works.summary: Five movements distinguish possessions from self, make joy the gift, and leave the giver as witness.

works.title: riola — On Work
works.summary: Gibran leads the reader from field to temple gate; Phi answers with rest, shared workload, and care made visible.
